title: Normalized ordinary and derived completed diagonal endpoints
statement: Fix a prime ell, a field k of prime characteristic p distinct from ell, and a finite type separated k-scheme Y with ell a unit on Y. Put W = P1_Y times_Y P1_Y. Choose all derived and Ext localizations of [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface] and [def-sfb-diagonal-limit-interface]. Let D be simultaneous derived reduction from integral sheaves to constant Z_ell-module strict systems and assume DiagonalCompletionSpec. Let H be a strict module system, roots an isomorphism of its underlying abelian tower with the prescribed root tower, and a,b isomorphisms from D.T of the supported integral source and of G_m[1] to the source tower in degree zero and H[2]. There exist a normalized total derived limit L and ordinary endpoint isomorphisms s,t. The source comparison preserves the canonical integer generator and every quotient projection; the underlying target comparison is the inverse of diagonalRootLimitComparison. The resulting diagonalSourceLimitMap and diagonalTargetLimitMap are isomorphisms. Both completed endpoints are right orthogonal to ell-invertible objects, in the completed category and after restriction to constant coefficients. No arrow between the endpoints or finite reduction comparison is asserted.

source.place: paragraph (1), ordinary and total inverse limits; paragraph (3), completeness of both endpoints

proof.text: The cokernel universal properties of D.ordinary identify the source tower with the supported finite constant tower, preserving quotient units and transitions. Closed direct image is exact and commutes with limits; its ordinary limit is the restricted completed constant. Its canonical generator gives exactly the displayed source projection equation.

Forgetting scalars creates the root limit. Apply the canonical preserved-limit comparison and the limit isomorphism induced by roots; the inverse has exactly the required underlying map. Root transitions are epimorphic because ell is invertible, and supported quotient transitions are epimorphic by closed exactness.

Use the Milnor comparison to identify ordinary limits of these two epimorphic towers with total derived limits. Choose a normalized DiagonalRlim from the total right derived data. Uniqueness of total right derived functors identifies its unit with this comparison. Compose with a and b, and the canonical shift comparison, to obtain the two specified isomorphisms.

DiagonalCompletionSpec identifies these total limits with derived-complete outputs after forgetting constant scalars. Transport orthogonality through the endpoint isomorphisms. The flat constant-completion equivalence and its principal-ideal criterion give intrinsic orthogonality over the completed ring as well. This proves completeness in both categories without constructing any morphism between the endpoints.

Each finite root group is annihilated by ell^(n+1), so its constant Z_l action factors through Z_l/ell^(n+1)=Z/ell^(n+1); the underlying root isomorphisms are consequently linear. The flat coefficient comparisons Z to constant Z_l and constant Z_l to the completed coefficient sheaf preserve all finite quotients. Complete-object equivalences first reflect completeness into constant coefficients and then transfer it to completed coefficients.

theorem diagonal_limit_endpoints (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hY : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalCompleted ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalCompleted ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (hcompletion : DiagonalCompletionSpec ℓ (diagonalSurface Y) D)
    (H : DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))
    (roots : H ⋙ diagonalForget ℓ (diagonalSurface Y) ≅
      Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower (diagonalSurface Y) ℓ (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime))
    (a : D.T.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (D.ordinary.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)))
    (b : D.T.obj (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (diagonalComparisonUnits Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj H)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) :
    ∃ (L : DiagonalRlim (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)))
      (s : (diagonalCompletedRestriction ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
        (diagonalCompletedSource ℓ Y) ≅ limit (D.ordinary.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)))
      (t : (diagonalCompletedRestriction ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
        (Scheme.purTwistZlModule (diagonalSurface Y) ℓ) ≅ limit H),
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        diagonalCompletedGenerator ℓ Y ≫ (diagonalForget ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)).map
          (s.hom ≫ limit.π (D.ordinary.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)) (op n)) =
        (diagonalScalarAdjunction ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)).unit.app (diagonalIntegralSource Y) ≫
          (diagonalForget ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)).map
            ((D.ordinary.π n).app (diagonalIntegralSource Y))) ∧
      HEq ((diagonalForget ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)).map t.hom)
        (diagonalRootLimitComparison ℓ (diagonalSurface Y) H roots).inv ∧
      IsIso (diagonalSourceLimitMap ℓ Y D a L s) ∧
      IsIso (diagonalTargetLimitMap ℓ Y D H b L t) ∧
      (∀ V : DerivedCategory (DiagonalCompleted ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)),
        IsIso (ℓ • 𝟙 V) → Subsingleton (V ⟶ diagonalCompletedDomain ℓ Y)) ∧
      (∀ V : DerivedCategory (DiagonalCompleted ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)),
        IsIso (ℓ • 𝟙 V) → Subsingleton (V ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain ℓ Y)) ∧
      (∀ V : DerivedCategory (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)),
        IsIso (ℓ • 𝟙 V) → Subsingleton (V ⟶
          (diagonalCompletedUnderlying ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
            (diagonalCompletedDomain ℓ Y))) ∧
      (∀ V : DerivedCategory (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)),
        IsIso (ℓ • 𝟙 V) → Subsingleton (V ⟶
          (diagonalCompletedUnderlying ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
            (diagonalCompletedCodomain ℓ Y)))
